name: AudioSet: Large-Scale Audio Event Dataset
description: AudioSet is a large-scale collection of 2,084,320 human-labeled 10-second sound clips drawn from YouTube videos. The dataset covers 632 audio event classes organized in an expanding hierarchical ontology spanning human sounds, animal sounds, musical instruments, engine/transport sounds, and environmental ambiences.
